# István Zoltán Szász — Junior Full-Stack Developer

> István Zoltán Szász (also written Istvan Zoltan Szasz, username istvanszasz99) is a Junior Full-Stack Web Developer and Computer Science Engineer based in Érd, Hungary. He builds modern, responsive web applications with React, Next.js and TypeScript, and holds a BSc in Computer Science Engineering from Óbuda University (February 2025). He is open to freelance projects, full-time roles and collaborations.

**Contact and status**

- Email: istvanszasz99@gmail.com
- Location: Érd, Hungary; works remotely
- At a glance: 4 certifications, 10+ projects completed, 30+ technologies
- Soft skills: problem-solving, communication, teamwork
- Hobbies: cooking, hardware repair (laptops, PCs, phones and tablets), following Formula 1 and WEC motorsport

**Summary**

István has developed full-stack applications through academic, certificate-based and independent projects, working across the entire stack from user interface to debugging and deployment. His frontend expertise centres on React and Next.js, and his backend work covers Node.js, Express.js, REST API design and SQL and NoSQL databases. He also works on mobile development with React Native and 3D development with Unreal Engine 5.

**Work experience**

- Full-Stack Web Developer at MolnarCodes, remote, March 2026 – May 2026. He made client websites fully responsive, proposed and implemented UI/UX improvements, implemented SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), integrated Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and GSAP into production work, and refactored client codebases. Key projects: solidfinances.hu and mindenegyseg.hu.

**Education**

- BSc, Computer Science Engineering, Óbuda University, Alba Regia Faculty of Engineering, Székesfehérvár, Hungary, September 2019 – February 2025. Thesis: simulation of the Óbuda University campus in a 3D environment using Unreal Engine 5.
- High school diploma, specialisation in Computer Science, Bálint Márton Vocational Secondary School, Törökbálint, Hungary, September 2014 – May 2019.

**Technical skills**

- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES2020+), Redux, HTML5, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Motion, GSAP, shadcn/ui, responsive and mobile-first design, SEO, GEO, performance optimisation, Chrome DevTools
- Backend: Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, Python, Django, C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, REST API design, authentication, validation and secure server-side logic
- DevOps and cloud: CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, Cloudflare, serverless hosting
- Databases and APIs: PostgreSQL, SQL, MongoDB, NoSQL, GraphQL
- Mobile: React Native, Expo, Android Studio, mobile UI/UX
- 3D: Unreal Engine 5, Twinmotion, Blueprints visual scripting, C++, level design and world-building
- UI/UX: UI design, UX research principles, design systems, wireframing and prototyping with Figma
- Other tools: Git, GitHub, Claude Code, Electron, Visual Studio Code, Microsoft Office, macOS, Windows
